records.source: Reuters / Sam Li / China Gas Venture Global increased LNG contract
records.claim: China Gas announced on Nov18 a 20-year LNG agreement replacing September 500000 tons per year with 1 million tons per year. Delivery possible as early as 2030, with total Chinese buyer long-term LNG portfolio 4 million tons/year.
records.observation: Commercial contractual expansion on Nov18; not commissioned current gas delivery.
records.assessment: DATED EVIDENCE — DO NOT INFER UNOBSERVED PHYSICAL THROUGHPUT

records.source: Reuters / ADNOC L&S Hormuz ship attack company confirmation
records.claim: On Nov18 ADNOC L&S reported a Nov17 Hormuz vessel attack, one missing crew member, eleven injured, other crew evacuated. Reuters separate Iranian claims of additional vessels burning were not independently verified.
records.observation: Physical incident Nov17 confirmed Nov18; no assertion of lost oil/LPG tonnage or company-named vessel identity.
records.assessment: DATED EVIDENCE — DO NOT INFER UNOBSERVED PHYSICAL THROUGHPUT

records.source: Reuters / Jeslyn Lerh / US API oil stocks and Hormuz maritime risk
records.claim: Market sources citing API reported a Nov13 weekly US crude stock build of 5.28 million barrels, gasoline 5.12m, distillate 0.351m. Brent and WTI fell at 0745 GMT Nov18 as maritime disruption persisted.
records.observation: Private industry stock estimate for week ending Nov13; not an official EIA figure or Nov18 physical increment.
records.assessment: DATED EVIDENCE — DO NOT INFER UNOBSERVED PHYSICAL THROUGHPUT
